original.statement: The `default` block of the runtime overrides config file (added in 2.9) was removed; set default values in the top-level `operational_config` of the standard Loki config instead.

decision.reason: [ev-0316e25d4611] says the `default` section of the runtime overrides config file was removed, so the subject is the `default` key owned by the runtime config file. The same text says "The `default` block was removed and instead a top level config now exists in the standard Loki config called `operational_config`". That supports a "removed" change with `operational_config` as its replacement. The validators prove nothing either way because the chart render failed.
